newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 3,800 head were exported into the United States at four crossing points Wednesday.

Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 1,000 steer calves were sold at prices 1-2 cents/lb lower compared to last week. "Trade moderate, demand moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 91-101 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 81-91 cents/lb.

Through Nogales, Arizona, around 1,000 head were sold at steady prices for steer calves, the USDA said. Prices were 90-100 cents/lb for head weighing 300-400 lb and for 400-500 lb head they were 80-90 cents/lb.
Through, Presidio, Texas around 1,800 head were sold at mostly steady prices. Prrices for 300-400 lb head were 92-102 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head they were 82-92 cents/lb.
